title.zh: Meta发布Muse Wonder与Muse Wonder Full前沿AI模型
title.en: Meta releases Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full frontier AI models

current_state.zh: Meta has released Muse Wonder, its first frontier-class model, which is larger and scores higher on benchmarks than the lightweight Muse Spark, with improved performance on complex tasks such as coding.
current_state.en: Meta has released Muse Wonder, its first frontier-class model, which is larger and scores higher on benchmarks than the lightweight Muse Spark, with improved performance on complex tasks such as coding.

updates.title_zh: Meta has some Wonder Full new AI models

updates.what_changed_zh: Meta launched two new AI models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, from its Superintelligence Labs, claiming they can compete with the industry's leading models.
